messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide drops price to $0.12 per mile. Wait time now 8 minutes. Coverage expanded to residential areas. Partnership wit
You notice more robotaxis on the streets. About 7% of people seem to be using them regularly.
Some people seem optimistic: Mark Thompson.

Frank sold the lower-value school vehicle — a 2016 Honda Civic used for student lessons — through a combination of Facebook Marketplace and a quick offer from an Auto Row used lot, netting roughly $4,500 after the outstanding insurance cancellation. The adult ed coordinator, Sandra Reyes, returned his closing call and said exactly what Frank feared: she appreciates the curriculum document and Mark Thompson's endorsement, but the spring catalog decisions aren't made until the district committee meets in three weeks — she can't give him a yes today, but she hasn't said no. Howard Liu's call turned out to be relevant: Howard had heard through Mark that Frank was developing an AV literacy curriculum and wanted to know if Frank might be interested in doing a single-session workshop for his parts store employees, whose work increasingly involves EV diagnostics. It is not steady income, but it is a real ask from a real person. Mark confirmed the board has not yet voted but the secretary said a formal decision is expected within the next two ticks.
